2609.04865.title: CoSkill: Joint Reinforcement Learning of Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents for Hierarchical Skill Evolution
2609.04865.paper_summary: Skill libraries improve the sample efficiency of agentic reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge. Yet existing paradigms exhibit structural shortcomings: they either decouple skill evolution from policy optimization or instantiate meta-skills as fixed workflows. Both treat skills as passive objects to be managed, limiting the flexible evolution of skills and their co-adaptation with the reasoning agent. To address the limitations, we propose CoSkill, a unified multi-agent RL framework that recasts the static meta-skill workflow as a learnable Meta-Skill Agent and jointly trains it with a Reasoning Agent over a hierarchical skill library. By modeling the Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents as a cooperative team sharing a single backbone, CoSkill enables end-to-end co-adaptation: the Reasoning Agent conditions its actions on a retrieved task skill and step skills selected from its child set, while its task performance guides the Meta-Skill Agent in refining those step skills. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that CoSkill substantially outperforms prior skill-based and RL baselines, achieving success rates of 98.4% and 90.6%, respectively (+3.5 and +6.2 pp). As shown in Figure 1, CoSkill achieves superior early-stage sample efficiency, asymptotic performance, and wall-clock efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/jinyuan-cookie/CoSkill.
2609.04865.paper_summary_zh: 技能庫透過使大型語言模型（LLM）代理重用程序性知識來提高代理強化學習（RL）的樣本效率。然而，現有的範式存在結構上的缺陷：它們要麼將技能演變與策略優化分開，要麼將元技能實現為固定的工作流程。這兩者都將技能視為被管理的被動對象，限制了技能的靈活演變及其與推理代理的共同適應。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了CoSkill，一個統一的多代理RL框架，將靜態的元技能工作流程重新構建為可學習的元技能代理，並與推理代理在層次技能庫上進行聯合訓練。通過將推理和元技能代理建模為共享單一主幹的合作團隊，CoSkill實現了端到端的共同適應：推理代理根據檢索到的任務技能和從其子集選擇的步驟技能來調整其行動，而其任務表現則指導元技能代理精煉這些步驟技能。在ALFWorld和WebShop上的實驗顯示，CoSkill顯著超越了先前的基於技能和RL的基準，成功率分別達到98.4%和90.6%（分別提高3.5和6.2個百分點）。如圖1所示，CoSkill在早期階段的樣本效率、漸近性能和實時計算效率上均表現優越。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/jinyuan-cookie/CoSkill獲得。
